entries.name: Kirito — Starburst Stream,16 contacts
entries.sourceWork: Sword Art Online Aincrad television arc (2012), dual blades after skill reveal
entries.characterVersion: Aincrad television2012 after Dual Blades skill reveal; Elucidator right/Dark Repulser left

normalization.method: Connected complete native bodies; explicitly reviewed rectangular source imports, one shared anatomical scale, nearest-neighbor packing and actual solid-boot registration. No paint, mirror, pose cloning or art repair.

calibration.reason: First drawing is a leaning, bent-knee sword contact. Projected crown-to-sole204px remains shorter than its measured articulated246px body path. Neither sword, coat spread nor raised arm defines stature. One shared scale preserves every native lower projection.

reviewEvidence.observation: All sixteen complete bodies and both held blades are visible; red circles sit on physical Elucidator metal and cyan circles on physical Dark Repulser metal. Feet share the real solid-sole baseline, black coat/white piping and native lower contact projections remain intact. Thirty-two blade points were inspected, not painted onto published art.

limitations: Original generated contact poses, not official source animation frames.
Opposite facing mirrors both outfit and anatomical handedness.
The anatomical path is a manual visual estimate on a leaning contact, not an official character-height measurement.
